cases.causal_label: The mobile test selected the first dashboard card. A duplicate empty xref dashboard left by another test was first, so the chart assertion failed on the wrong dashboard.
evidence: Bundled JSON reader: three failed chart-container visibility attempts.
Bundled media snapshot: empty xref_dash_ dashboard with the no-charts state at the failing attempt.
Run-head source: openFirstDashboard clicks cards.first() and the failing test calls it.
Maintainer PR #44856 explicitly identifies the leaked duplicate, changes the Save modal to select an exact existing dashboard, and changes the mobile test to open a known sample dashboard.
cases.fix_validation: PR reports targeted local mobile tests passing; PR Playwright checks were green. The exact failed run was not rerun against the fix here.
cases.scope_limit: This label applies to this run, not automatically to the other 54 same-hash mobile events. The latest sampled post-merge PR head still contained openFirstDashboard, so calendar date alone does not prove it included the fix.
